title: RuView — Health States
description: Per-node vitals and semantic life states from the sensing-server's built-in MQTT publisher.

options.content: Data from the sensing-server's built-in MQTT publisher (one series per ESP32 node). HR/BR are only published once the room is calibrated and someone is present, so gaps mean *absent or not calibrated*, not a fault. HR/BR are still room-level, not per person.

panels.title: Life states (any node)
panels.description: Semantic states from the sensing-server (ADR-115 HA-MIND). 1 = on.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ha_binary" and r._field == "on")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.entity, set: ["someone_sleeping", "no_movement", "possible_distress", "elderly_inactivity_anomaly", "room_active", "bathroom_occupied", "meeting_in_progress", "presence"]))
  |> group(columns: ["entity"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "entity"])

import "strings"
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ha_sensor" and r.entity == "heart_rate" and r._field == "bpm")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 30.0 and r._value < 200.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with node: strings.replace(v: r.device, t: "wifi_densepose_", u: "", i: 1)}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node"])

panels.title: Events per 15 min (fall, bed exit, room transition)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ha_event" and r._field == "event_type")
  |> group(columns: ["entity"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "entity"])
